title: Orion Studio platform manifest
description: Emitted by one platform build job. The release assembly job re-reads every manifest and re-hashes every artifact, so the digests recorded here are claims, not trust.

tag.description: Immutable release tag the artifact was built from.

commit.description: Full commit SHA resolved once by validate_release. Every platform must report the same value.

version.description: Cargo package version. Must equal the tag without its leading v.

channel.description: Release channel the artifact was built for. Stable artifacts must report stable.

artifact.description: File name of the distributable. Must be listed in the assembly job's allowlist.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the artifact. The assembly job recomputes this value.

signed.description: Whether the platform's native signature gate passed. Unsigned artifacts can never be promoted to Stable.
